title: Boilerclaw Porter
text: Boilerclaw Porter mistakes living bodies for fuel canisters and tries to stack them for collection. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The loading order has outlived the station.

defeatReward.text: Boilerclaw Porter is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
